pctunex.title: PC TuneX Ultra - Repair and clean your Windows PC
pctunex.description: Run one health check, then repair what it finds and get back the space junk was taking. Over 100 repair and maintenance tools in one place, with an honest health score that counts only the problems the app can really fix.

pcturboxultra.title: PC TurboX Ultra - Full PC optimisation with Turbo Boost and Game Mode
pcturboxultra.description: One-click Turbo Boost reclaims memory, clears junk and sets a high performance power plan, then shows exactly what it did. Game Mode, Startup Manager and live gauges are all on your PC.

spatiaxultra.title: SpatiaX Ultra - Real-time 3D spatial audio engine for Windows
spatiaxultra.description: A real-time audio engine that transforms your headphone or speaker experience with 3D spatial sound and signature profiles, all running locally on your PC.

horizonos.title: CrystalunaOS - A glass desktop on one hotkey
horizonos.description: Press one hotkey and a full-screen glass desktop opens over Windows, with live wallpapers, a command bar that understands plain words and widgets that actually do things.

nexusos.title: GlactisOS - A neon desktop that reacts to your PC
nexusos.description: A live synthwave grid that surges with your real processor load, glowing system panels read straight from Windows, and a complete desktop shell on top.

quantumos.title: KatanicOS - A live anime desktop for Windows
quantumos.description: Anime-style live wallpapers that move with your processor, memory and network, a torii dock for every app and window, and widgets that report what is really happening.

limonaos.title: LimonaOS - A bright citrus desktop for Windows
limonaos.description: Bright citrus scenes that move with your processor, memory and network, a counter dock for every app and window, and a launcher that runs on one keystroke.

prisnovaos.title: PrisnovaOS - A live desktop cut from light
prisnovaos.description: Prism scenes that move with your processor, memory and network, a dock for every app and window, and widgets that report the truth about your PC.

redspawnos.title: RedspawnOS - A gaming desktop that reads your rig
redspawnos.description: Bold gaming scenes that move with your processor, memory and network, a dock for every app and window, and live readouts without alt-tabbing to a monitor tool.

earthos.title: EarthvisOS - The real Earth as your desktop
earthos.description: A live satellite map of the world behind everything you do, lit by real daylight and city lights from the sun's actual position, with a complete desktop shell on top.
